rule.c1: external AUC bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0.5 IN THE BENEFICIAL direction (CI lower bound > 0.5)

calibration_curves.method: LOCO M2 frozen predictions, 5 equal-frequency bins with exact Clopper-Pearson 95% CI; M3 = 100 stratified 50/50 supervised recalibration repeats (repeat means + representative fold); _supporting_analyses machinery verbatim

M2.model: M2 = frozen S0 ridge (both PCs) trained on the pooled other two cohorts, verbatim  F4 /  algebra (lambda=1/n_train); new  recovered-key anchor

M3.model: M3 = M2 linear predictor eta + target-internal stratified 50/50 supervised logistic recalibration logit(p)=a+b*eta, x 100 repeats (seed 20260911), verbatim / protocol

representative_fold.rule: repeat whose eval-half log-loss is closest to the median of the 100 eval-half log-losses (ties -> smallest index)

M3.note: The representative fold supplies the plotted curve; inference rests on the repeat means (/ frozen convention).

near_miss.note: near-miss = configuration that clears one licensing criterion but not the other; the full confirmation table includes M0 (constant predictions, degenerate CI [0.5,0.5]) and answers the question: does ANY direction x model have an AUC CI excluding 0.5 in the beneficial direction under the new anchor numbers?
